options.name: --database
options.description: OBSOLETE: Please specify the connection string instead

options.name: --connectionstring
options.description: You now provide an entire connection string. ServerName and Database are obsolete.

options.name: --sqlfilesdirectory
options.description: The directory where your SQL scripts are

options.name: --output
options.description: This is where everything related to the migration is stored. This includes any backups, all items that ran, permission dumps, logs, etc.

options.name: --folders
options.description:
Folder configuration.
If you wish to override any of the default folder names, supply a semicolon separated list of mappings.
You can also specify a file name that has the same contents as you would supply on the command line,
if you find it cumbersome to write all the folders on the command line.
Example:
--folders 'up=ddl;views=projections;beforemigration=preparefordeploy'
or
--folders myfolderconfig.txt
,and put the following content in `myfolderconfig.txt`(either semicolon or newline separated)
up=ddl
views=projections
beforemigration=preparefordeploy
this will keep the default folder configuration, but change the names of the folders you supply.
If you want to fully customise the folders, you can do this by specifying a list of folders with keys
that are not among the default folders. Then none of the default folders will be configured, just the ones you supply.
Example:
--folders folder1=path:a/sub/folder/here,type:Once,connectionType:Admin;folder2=type:EveryTime;folder3=type:AnyTime
The properties you can set per folder, are:
* Name - the key/name you wish to give to the folder (doesn't matter if path is specified)
* Path - the relative path of the folder, relative to the --sqlfilesdirectory parameter.
Defaults to the name given above.
* Type - the type of the migration (Once, EveryTime, Anytime), defaults to Once,
* ConnectionType - whether to run on the default connection, or on the admin (defaults to Default),
Allowed values: default, admin
* TransactionHandling - whether to be part of the transaction, or run the script even on a rollback,
defaults to Default
Allowed values: default, autonomous
There are also short forms, if you just wish to supply the folder name or the migration type.
Example:
--folders folder1=my/first/scripts;folder2=the/last/ones;folder3=something/i/forgot
or
--folders folder1=Once;folder2=Everytime;folder3=Anytime
the last one will expect the folders to be named 'folder1', 'folder2', and 'folder3', in the sqlfilesdirectory.

options.name: --instance
options.description: OBSOLETE: Please specify the connection string instead.

options.name: -csa
options.description: The connection string for connecting to master, if you want to create the database.  Defaults to the same as --connstring.

options.name: --accesstoken
options.description: Access token to be used for logging in to SQL Server / Azure SQL Database.

options.name: --commandtimeout
options.description: This is the timeout when commands are run. This is not for admin commands or restore.

options.name: --admincommandtimeout
options.description: This is the timeout when administration commands are run (except for restore, which has its own).

options.name: --databasetype
options.description: TELLS sqldep WHAT TYPE OF DATABASE IT IS RUNNING ON.

options.name: --transaction
options.description: Run the migration in a transaction

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment Name - This allows SqlDeployer to be environment aware and only run scripts that are in a particular environment based on the name of the script.  'something.ENV.LOCAL.sql' would only be run if --env=LOCAL was set.

options.name: --sc
options.description: The schema to use for the migration tables

options.name: --noninteractive
options.description: Silent - instructs SqlDeployer not to ask for any input when it runs.

options.name: -r
options.description: Repository Path - The repository. A string that can be anything. Used to track versioning along with the version. Defaults to NULL.

options.name: --version
options.description: Database Version - specify the version of the current migration directly on the command line.

options.name: --drop
options.description: Drop - This instructs SqlDeployer to remove the target database.

options.name: --createdatabase
options.description: Create - This instructs SqlDeployer to create the target database if it does not exist.  Defaults to true.

options.name: --disabletokenreplacement
options.description: Tokens - This instructs SqlDeployer to not perform token replacement ({{somename}}). Defaults to false.

options.name: -w
options.description: WarnOnOneTimeScriptChanges - Instructs SqlDeployer to execute changed one time scripts(DDL / DML in Up folder) that have previously been run against the database instead of failing.  A warning is logged for each one time script that is rerun. Defaults to false.

options.name: --warnandignoreononetimescriptchanges
options.description: WarnAndIgnoreOnOneTimeScriptChanges - Instructs SqlDeployer to ignore and update the hash of changed one time scripts (DDL/DML in Up folder) that have previously been run against the database instead of failing. A warning is logged for each one time scripts that is rerun. Defaults to false.

options.name: --ut
options.description: User Tokens - Allows SqlDeployer to perform token replacement on custom tokens ({{my_token}}). Set as a key=value pair, eg '--ut=my_token=myvalue'. Can be specified multiple times.

options.name: --donotstorescriptsruntext
options.description: DoNotStoreScriptsRunText - This instructs SqlDeployer to not store the full script text in the database. Defaults to false.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Baseline - This instructs SqlDeployer to mark the scripts as run, but not to actually run anything against the database. Use this option if you already have scripts that have been run through other means (and BEFORE you start the new ones).

options.name: --runallanytimescripts
options.description: RunAllAnyTimeScripts - This instructs SqlDeployer to run any time scripts every time it is run even if they haven't changed. Defaults to false.

options.name: --dryrun
options.description: DryRun - This instructs SqlDeployer to log what would have run, but not to actually run anything against the database.  Use this option if you are trying to figure out what SqlDeployer is going to do.

options.name: --restore
options.description: Restore - This instructs SqlDeployer where to get the backed up database file. Defaults to NULL.

options.name: --ignoredirectorynames
options.description: IgnoreDirectoryNames - By default, scripts are ordered by relative path including subdirectories. This option searches subdirectories, but order is based on filename alone.

options.name: --uptodatecheck
options.description: Outputs whether the database is up to date or not (whether any non-everytime scripts would be run)

options.name: --output-format
options.description: Output format for execution results. 'text' for human-readable output (default), 'json' for structured JSON output suitable for programmatic consumption.

options.name: --backup
options.description: Create a database backup before running migrations.

options.name: --backup-path
options.description: Custom directory path for the backup file.

options.name: --skip-backup
options.description: Skip backup even if --backup is configured in the project config.

options.name: --hooks
options.description: Directory containing shell script hooks (beforeMigrate.sh, afterMigrate.sh, etc.).

options.name: --profile
options.description: Enable performance profiling — per-script timing, query plans, and warnings for slow operations.

options.name: --otel-endpoint
options.description: OpenTelemetry OTLP endpoint for exporting traces and metrics (e.g., http://localhost:4317).

options.name: --policy
options.description: Path to a policy file (.sqldeployer-policy.json) for enforcement.

options.name: --require-approval
options.description: Require an approval signature before executing migration.

options.name: --tenant-list
options.description: Path to a JSON file listing tenant connection strings for multi-tenant migrations.

options.name: --retry-failed
options.description: Retry previously failed tenants only (used with --tenant-list).

options.name: --strategy
options.description: Migration strategy: 'default' or 'expand-contract'.

options.name: --finalize
options.description: Finalize a previously started expand-contract migration (remove old structures).

options.name: --policy-override
options.description: Bypass allowed-window and blackout-date policy checks with a mandatory reason (written to the audit trail).

options.name: --policy-override-token
options.description: HMAC token that authorises the --policy-override. Required when a policy-override token is configured.

options.name: --lock-timeout
options.description: Seconds to wait for the distributed migration lock before exiting with LockContention (exit code 22). 0 disables the lock (default).

options.name: --auto-rollback
options.description: When a verify script fails, automatically execute the Down/ chain in reverse order for all one-time scripts run in this session. A missing Down/ script is treated as a hard error and aborts the rollback.

options.name: --pg-restore-path
options.description: Full path to the pg_restore (or psql) binary. Resolved from PATH when not supplied.

options.name: --pg-dump-path
options.description: Full path to the pg_dump binary. Resolved from PATH when not supplied.

options.name: --mariadb-bin-path
options.description: Full path to the mariadb client binary (used for restore). Resolved from PATH when not supplied.

options.name: --mariadb-dump-path
options.description: Full path to the mariadb-dump (or mysqldump) binary (used for backup). Resolved from PATH when not supplied.

options.name: --impdp-path
options.description: Full path to the Oracle impdp (Data Pump import) binary. Resolved from PATH when not supplied.

options.name: --expdp-path
options.description: Full path to the Oracle expdp (Data Pump export) binary. Resolved from PATH when not supplied.

options.name: --explain
options.description: Before each DML/DQL statement, execute dialect-appropriate EXPLAIN and attach the plan to the audit record. DDL statements are skipped gracefully.

options.name: --explain-format
options.description: Format for EXPLAIN output when --explain is set: 'json' (default) or 'text' (dialect-specific).

options.name: -v
options.description: Verbosity level (as defined here: https://docs.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.LogLevel)
